title: WaitCondition
description: A declared condition on which an agent stops consuming compute until woken. Every wait carries a mandatory timeout (ADR 0007); waits are cancelled when their owning task reaches a terminal state.

task_id.description: Owning task, if any; terminal task state cancels the wait.

on_timeout.description: Default wakes the agent with a timeout outcome, leaving the semantic decision with the agent.
